2022.identifiedFinanceCreditMeaning: No additional named reversal adjustment selected for this historical scenario; not an absence claim.

2023.identifiedFinanceCreditMeaning: No additional named reversal adjustment selected for this historical scenario; not an absence claim.

2024.identifiedFinanceCreditMeaning: No additional named reversal adjustment selected for this historical scenario; not an absence claim.

2025.identifiedFinanceCreditMeaning: Explicit negative other-finance-cost line; net noninterest expense is grossed up in the conservative cost case.

method.capital: Operating assets = total assets - short/long financial investments - selected cash. Operating liabilities = explicit supplier/customer-advance/payroll + selected residual noninterest liabilities. Opening/closing use identical allocations and consolidated scope. Goodwill, CWIP and investment property retained; property operations remain in gross profit.
method.cash: 0/100% exclusion endpoints: no chosen amount is called unrestricted or freely spendable. Classification ranges are separate from S2 instrument liquidity.
method.coreEbit: gross profit - selling - G&A; finance income, JV/associate result and other income excluded
method.costOfCapital: No numeric default. Retained VNM 12/15/18% discount choices are valuation assumptions, not an appropriately supported WACC. TCB country table/risk inputs are not VNM capital cost or transferable issuer beta.
method.earningsScope: CONSOLIDATED, including NCI; not parent common EPS
method.incremental: Display matched deltas using available aggregate history. No ratio if capital-change comparability/materiality is not established, including nonpositive denominator; M3 §6.3 guard is preserved. Project/factory attribution not an automatic requirement.
method.leases: Consistent reported VAS operating-lease expense/book-asset basis; no unsupported capitalization or EBIT rent addback. Alternate economic lease capitalization not claimed complete.
method.nopat: (core EBIT - selected identified cost sensitivity)*(1-tax) - group fund appropriation
method.ranges: Economic sensitivity estimates under declared assumptions, not certified exhaustive confidence intervals or accepted scoring Evidence. Extrema taken from complete coherent scenarios; never combine unmatched numerator/capital endpoints.
method.recurringEconomicCompensation: Total group post-tax fund appropriation is charged once; cash fund use and dividends are not additionally deducted. EBIT-equivalent adjustment = appropriation/(1-tax).
method.residualPopulation: total liabilities - reported short/long borrowings - explicit supplier/customer-advance/payroll; 0/100% operating classification is sensitivity, not a claim all residuals are operating or non-operating.
method.tax: Primary 20% estimate anchored to company-tax reconciliation. Sensitivity uses minimum observed group effective rate FY22–25 to 20%; an historical, evidence-anchored scenario range, not a proven future tax bound.
